assessment_summary.cou_name: Set safe power/irrigation envelopes for a 7F open-irrigated RF ablation catheter in the left atrium; decision on peak 3 mm tissue temperature and lesion size at 30–60 s

evidence_keywords: Unit tests for UDF I/O and mapping pass CI on each commit.
UDF Git tag rfcht-v1.7 (commit 9f4a1b2)
run scripts in a Singularity container (hash 3c7…9a1)
Input decks, meshes, and outputs tracked by DVC
External SME (Dr. R. Ghuman) performed a red-team read
custom heat-source UDF and perfusion toggle were exercised against an artificially forced benchmark
closed-form temperature field with a tailored source
Energy residual over the control volume was <0.2% at steady state.
Four meshes (1.2M to 9.6M cells)
observed order 1.96 for peak temperature
extrapolated discretization effect 3.8% on peak temp
Time-step halving from 5 ms to 2.5 ms shifts peak temperature by 0.6 C
Second-order discretization, coupled solver
Residuals <1e-6
integral energy plateaus within 0.3% over last 10 s
Applicability: The intended clinical envelope (25–45 W, 17–30 mL/min, atrial blood speed 0.15–0.25 m/s, contact force 10–30 g) sits inside the tested/validated space.
We explicitly do not claim fidelity for steam pops, charring, or highly trabeculated surfaces.
We will maintain the containerized workflow
laminar assumed but bracketed with SST k-omega for sensitivity.
Joule heating represented as a volumetric source in tissue and electrode via a quasi-static electric field solution
Tissue perfusion via Pennes term outside the near-surface ablation zone.
no steam/char physics
Inputs and ranges: Tissue thermal/electrical properties (±15% about literature)
contact pressure (10–20 kPa)
blood speed (0.15–0.30 m/s), irrigation (17–30 mL/min)
Instrument calibrations attached
12 benchtop perfused-myocardium tests (porcine)
fiber-optic probes at 3 and 5 mm.
Lesion dimensions from 7T MRI (0.2 mm voxel).
Blood inflow 0.15–0.30 m/s, 37 C
irrigation 17–30 mL/min at 22 C
applied RF power 25–50 W with PI control matching generator logs.
esophageal wall as an isothermal boundary 37.0±0.2 C at 4 mm posterior.
Electrode, tip holes, and shaft from vendor CAD
contact pressure 10–20 kPa producing 0.2–0.5 mm indentation (from benchtop).
PI control matching generator logs
Mean absolute temperature error at 3 mm = 2.1 C; 95th percentile 4.0 C.
Normalized RMS error on lesion depth = 9%; width = 11%.
all cases fall within a 95% total-error band set in the plan.
One outlier at 45 W/0.15 m/s under-predicts depth by 15%
